messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled soft cut to green (service-router -> v2.4.0) at 2026-03-21T21:00Z. Plan: +10% every 2m, hold 5m on anomalies. Rollback triggers: p95 > 200ms for 3 probes OR error_rate > 5%. Announcing now. @Sam L @Rita C
Sam L: Oncall — I'll watch p95, CPU, and error rate. Ready to abort and snap back to blue if we hit triggers.
Rita C: Confirming v2.4.0 pinned: image= rwd-router:v2.4.0-20260321, config hash matches prod. Release notes posted: https://redwood/release/264 (small parsing tweak documented).
Maria G: Can we enable slow-drain on blue during shift to reduce session churn? If yes I'll set drain=soft at ~60% green.
Sam L: Yes — drain=soft + preserve-session-affinity for 5m after each step.
Rita C: deploy-bot — please output preflight checklist & canary test results.
deploy-bot: Preflight OK:
```
K8s nodes: Ready
Canary tests: pass (latency/regression)
Infra alarms: none
Model/route pin: rwd-router:v2.4.0 confirmed
Secrets: rotated(2026-03-20)
```
Ops Bot: Capacity check: green pool spare=30% (eu-west1/us-west2), autoscale-buffer=20%. No quota limits.
Sam L: Quick rollback command if needed:
`curl -XPOST https://ops/change-weight -d '{"from":"green","to":"blue","percent":100}'`
Rita C: FYI there's a minor metric flake on /metrics/cpu around 20:55 — don't treat that as a rollback reason unless it correlates with p95.
deploy-bot: Starting shift now — step 1 -> green=10% (blue=90%). state=running. current_weights: blue=90 green=10
Sam L: seeing small p95 bump +15ms at 21:02, still within tolerance.
Ops Bot: Auto-monitoring: p95=135ms, error_rate=0.5% (rolling 1m). No alerts.
Rita C: If p95 > 180ms OR error_rate > 2% hold and investigate. Otherwise continue.
deploy-bot: Step 3 -> green=50% reached at 21:10. current_weights: blue=50 green=50. Observability: https://dash/route/shift/2968501111
Maria G: Noticed perf regression for a small cohort hitting us-east-1 — elevated tail latencies and sticky sessions misrouting.
Sam L: Approve regional rollback for us-east-1 only. Execute regional revert to blue.
deploy-bot: Regional rollback executed: green(us-east-1)=0 -> blue(us-east-1)=100. Global green now 40% (us-west/eu unaffected).
Rita C: Holding global at 40% for 20m while triage continues. Marking release status: PARTIAL_ROLLOUT in release notes.
Maria G: Root cause looks like sticky-cookie header parsing regression in v2.4.0; hotfix branch created (hotfix/parse-cookie).
Sam L: Once hotfix is validated, we'll canary 20% global and then resume +10% steps. Keep oncall looped.
deploy-bot: Noted. Monitoring continues; I'll post updates for each step. Thread closed for coordination — followups in #eng-runtime if needed. /end
